examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as a product page opens with it: the large `title-band` with the overline, headline, sentence and both actions centered. A band with no title renders nothing, and one with no marks has no client strip.

examples.name: Variants
examples.summary: Every layout stacked: `center` over the dot field with the client strip, the large `title-band`, `copy-beside-art` with the illustration beside the copy, then `copy-on-top-art` with its copy centered over a scene in the window under it.

examples.name: Bands
examples.summary: The design sample's other openings: `center-band` (large, site-wide, centered), `compact-band` (short, copy at the start) with `title-length="long"` widening the headline, and a `plain` centered screen with a scene in the `bottom` slot.

examples.name: Image
examples.summary: `copy-beside-art` with an `image` instead of an illustration: the photograph fills the media column, and a portrait one is drawn at half width, centered, on narrow screens. The eyebrow takes the `</>` prefix.

examples.name: Topology
examples.summary: `copy-on-top-art` with no scene slot: `levels` draws the Workloads topology under the centered copy — two domains feed the lit workload, which binds an application and a firewall. A card with no title is skipped, and a band with no levels drops the scene.

examples.name: Arguments
examples.summary: The Firewall opening: the large title band with a long headline (`title-length="long"`), both actions, and one row of three arguments (`items`) framed under the hero floor. A band with no items drops the grid.

site.name: Centered carousel
site.summary: The home page hero: one screen with a dot field fading in from the top, the headline centered and the client strip on the floor. The solution pages use the same band with their own copy and clients.

site.name: Title band small
site.summary: The title band at the medium height, for a page whose bands start right under the headline (Contact).

site.name: Title band carousel
site.summary: The Learning Center and Support hero: the large title band with the client strip on its floor, for list and catalogue pages that open on proof.

site.name: Copy beside art
site.summary: Copy on one side and a wide illustration on the other, with the client strip on the floor; the illustration bleeds past the column edge from medium widths up.

site.name: Topology
site.summary: The Workloads hero: the copy centered over a topology drawn from `levels`, so the page JSON carries the scene as data.

site.name: Arguments
site.summary: The AI Gateway opening: the large title band with six arguments in two rows of three under it, for a page that argues on breadth.
